# eightctl

> Agent skill for careful Eight Sleep Pod control through eightctl.

## Use When

- The user asks to inspect or control an Eight Sleep Pod.
- The user asks for a Smart Alarm, alarm conversion, or alarm verification.
- The user asks whether recent sleep data shows an unusual recovery pattern.

## Commands

- `eightctl --quiet --output json status` for read-only Pod status.
- `python3 skills/eightctl/scripts/alarm.py list` for current alarms.
- `python3 skills/eightctl/scripts/alarm.py create-one-off ...` for verified Smart Alarms.
- `python3 skills/eightctl/scripts/health_watch.py --format json` for read-only screening.

## Safety

- Never expose config files, passwords, tokens, or raw authenticated responses.
- Confirm the exact target and values immediately before any mutation.
- Every alarm mutation must set and read back `smart.lightSleepEnabled: true`.
- Never replace Smart Alarm with a fixed-time fallback.
- Health-watch output is a personalized screening signal, not a diagnosis.

## Configuration

Keep `~/.config/eightctl/config.yaml` mode `600`. The public repository contains
no credentials or OAuth client secrets.
